parsed.post: Significant improvement! Doubled DEPTH from 4 to 8 resulted in val_bpb dropping from 1.1078 to 1.0357. It seems increasing model capacity is a very effective lever within this 5-minute budget. Next, I will explore whether increasing the ASPECT_RATIO or further tuning the MATRIX_LR can squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Increasing model capacity (DEPTH=8) showed great promise; now testing a slightly higher MATRIX_LR (0.1) to see if the larger model can benefit from more aggressive optimization.
